title: Data Science Essentials
summary: Built a predictive analytics pipeline with Python libraries for profiling, cleaning, visualization, modeling, clustering, and recommendations.

detail.contribution: Profiled and cleaned the dataset, built visualisations, selected features, compared models, applied K-Means clustering and wrote recommendations.

result.text: Gradient Boosting ranked first on the model leaderboard with 77.3% accuracy on a 1,744-row test set, ahead of Random Forest at 73.9%.

cardSummary: Built a Python predictive analytics pipeline covering cleaning, modelling and clustering. Gradient Boosting ranked first at 77.3% accuracy.

title: Full-Stacked Web Development
summary: Designed and developed a full-stack website using HTML for front-end design, JavaScript for functionality, and MySQL for back-end integration.

detail.contribution: Designed the relational database and SQL schema, built the Node.js/Express API and developed the front end that adds, updates and deletes products and categories.

title: Quantitative Analysis
summary: Conducted statistical tests(chi-square, correlation) in excel & python to validate hypothesis and assess data relationships, and applied linear regression for dataset splitting and model accuracy.

detail.contribution: Ran chi-square tests in Excel and built a multiple linear regression model in Python, including data cleaning, feature selection and ANOVA evaluation.

result.text: The multiple linear regression model for car prices reached an R² of 0.831 (adjusted R² 0.825) on 163 observations.

cardSummary: Tested hypotheses with chi-square tests in Excel and built a multiple linear regression model in Python for car prices (R² 0.831).

title: Data Warehouse & Business Intelligence
summary: Built a data warehouse using SQL and used Alteryx for ETL and to create visuals showing trends and insights for business improvement.

detail.contribution: Designed the star schema in SQL, prepared and cleaned the booking data in Alteryx, then built the visuals and recommendations.

cardSummary: Designed a SQL star-schema data warehouse and used Alteryx for ETL and visuals that show business trends and recommendations.

title: Data Visualization & Analytics
summary: Performed cleaning, transformation, clustering, and regression analysis using KNIME, and built Power BI dashboards to uncover customer behavior and insights.

detail.contribution: Cleaned and transformed the data in KNIME, formed four K-Means clusters, trained a linear regression model and visualised results in Power BI.

result.text: The linear regression model predicting restaurant ratings reached an R² of 0.823 with a mean absolute error of 0.116.
result.alt: Result evidence: KNIME model statistics screenshot

cardSummary: Cleaned data and built K-Means clusters and a regression model in KNIME to predict restaurant ratings (R² 0.823), visualised in Power BI.
